gui.blockloggerlowlevelnote: Low-level aggregation/load-shedding options remain in NewfiesBlocklogger.json.
gui.playerhistoryhelp: Player history: global world history by name or UID; prefixes are supported.
gui.searchoptionalhelp: Tip: Search is optional. Leave it blank to show nearby history.
gui.teleporttabhelp: Goto, bring, back, and send-back helpers using the suite teleport safeguards.
gui.playeradminpermissions: <font color="#91a0ae">Lookup uses nse.player.view; restorative actions and self Ghost mode use nse.player.manage.</font>
gui.moderationdurationhelp: <font color="#91a0ae">Duration examples: 30m, 6h, 2d, permanent. Record ID is only used for Remove Warn / Remove Note.</font>
gui.mapteleporthelp: Map teleport: right-click the world map and use the Server Essentials Teleport Here action.
gui.teleportsafetyhelp: <font color="#91a0ae">Goto, Bring and Back use server-side privilege checks plus Anti-Cheat trusted transitions.</font>
gui.inventoryeditorhelp: Load the player, select a slot, or search the item registry and use the result directly.
gui.itemsearchhelp: Search results have a Use Item button that copies the exact registry code into this editor.
gui.inventorybackuphelp: <font color="#ffd166">Slot edits create automatic backup snapshots. Reload if another system changes the inventory while you are editing it.</font>
gui.inventoryslothelp: <font color="#91a0ae">Loaded inventories render as real Vintage Story slots. Click any slot to load its inventory ID, slot, quantity, and item code into the editor.</font>
gui.serverconfirmhelp: <font color="#ffd166">Destructive/server lifecycle actions require a second click within 5 seconds.</font>
gui.reportstatushelp: <font color="#91a0ae">For Set Status use Open, Investigating, or Resolved. Assign defaults to yourself if blank.</font>
gui.acrulesstagedhelp: <font color="#91a0ae">Rules are staged locally until Save Rules. Detection/reporting continues even with no automatic rules.</font>
gui.acapplycurrentsessions: Apply matching rules to current sessions when saved
gui.acautomaticwarning: <font color="#ffd166">Kick / TempBan / Freeze rules are automatic moderation. Review trigger/value/subject carefully before enabling them.</font>
gui.settingsstagedhelp: <font color="#91a0ae">Changes are staged locally until Save Settings is pressed.</font>
gui.packetsaverefreshhelp: <font color="#91a0ae">Saving refreshes PacketGuard and re-evaluates current sessions.</font>
gui.cadencewarning: <font color="#ffd166">Recommended: observe cadence findings before enabling rejection on a live server.</font>
gui.acsummaryhelp: <font color="#91a0ae">Summary cards show identity, risk, client build, and runtime state. Detailed evidence stays in the timeline below.</font>
gui.reportpersistencehelp: <font color="#91a0ae">Reports survive reconnects/restarts. Risk delta is historical evidence only and is not automatically restored when a player reconnects.</font>
gui.mapsettingsstaged: Changes are staged until Save Map Settings is pressed. Live player coordinates remain off unless explicitly enabled.
gui.livecoordswarning: Live player coordinates are public when this switch is enabled.
gui.webpanelsettingshelp: Listener, access control, sessions, and public endpoint settings. Changes save per control.
gui.httpsecuritywarning: Direct HTTP is not encrypted. For Internet-facing access, put the listener behind HTTPS and enable Secure cookies.
gui.loginsettingsimmediate: Changes are saved immediately to NewfiesLoginProtection.json.
gui.mobtotalhelp: Mob Total is the aggregate for that mob across scanned regions. Protected entities do not consume the cull quota; OVER compares eligible count to Limit.
gui.customradiushelp: Custom radius overrides the Default Radius from Settings.
gui.noanimalrules: No Animal Limiter rules or exclusions are configured.
gui.animalsettingsimmediate: Changes are saved immediately to NewfiesAnimalLimiter.json.
gui.animalfreshdisabled: Fresh installs start disabled to prevent accidental removals.
gui.perruleradiushelp: Per-rule radius is set on the Limiter tab; Default radius is only the fallback.
gui.switchessavehelp: Switches save immediately. Numeric fields use their Save button.
gui.limittargethelp: Limit Target uses the entity under your crosshair.
gui.radiusscalehelp: Saved with Set Rule / Limit Target. 0=1x1, 1=3x3, 2=5x5, 3=7x7
gui.newruleeditorready: New rule editor ready. Set the fields, then Add / Update Rule.
gui.selectrulebeforedelete: Select a rule before deleting it.
gui.profilerenablefirst: Profiler is disabled. Enable Profiler first.
gui.pressscanpopulation: Press Scan Population to load current counts.

gui.packetprotectiontip: PacketGuard feedback, collision/noclip hardening, acceleration tuning and diagnostics.
gui.packetprotectionhelp: Live PacketGuard controls. Changes are staged until Save Packet is pressed. Use the tabs below for movement, reach, mining/TPS, and risk tuning.
gui.noclipwarningtip: Collision/noclip checks can false-positive on complex modded collision shapes. Keep disabled unless you need it and review reports after enabling.
gui.packetadvancedwebhelp: Advanced movement/reach/mining limits, teleport compatibility, exemptions and per-family risk thresholds remain available in the WebPanel.
gui.packetadvancednowingame: Advanced PacketGuard controls are now available here in-game. Save Packet applies the full PacketGuard configuration live.
gui.reachthresholdhelp: These controls tune lag compensation and repeat-strike handling before reach enforcement. Increase carefully to avoid weakening real reach checks.
gui.familyriskhelp: Each family decays independently. Review and Suspicious thresholds apply only to that family, preventing unrelated findings from stacking into one punishment score.
gui.correlationriskhelp: With per-family risk enabled, correlation is supporting evidence only. History settings control how long Anti-Cheat reports are retained.
gui.clientsettingssavehelp: <font color="#91a0ae">This page now saves client-scanner settings only. PacketGuard settings are saved from Packet Protection.</font>
gui.packetsettingsmovedhelp: All PacketGuard controls have been consolidated under Packet Protection so movement, reach, mining, TPS, compatibility, diagnostics and risk tuning are no longer split across two pages.
gui.packetsettingssavehelp: Open Packet Protection to change or save PacketGuard settings. Saving this Settings page will not overwrite PacketGuard values.
gui.tip.integrations: Configure the WebPanel, WebMap, and unified Discord module.
gui.tip.discord: Configure Discord connection status, announcements, account linking, and channel routing.
gui.restartrelaunchhelp: Host/panel/wrapper relaunches the process after NSE performs the clean shutdown.
gui.jailhelp: Jail uses the Duration and Reason fields. Set Jail stores your current position as the server jail cell.
gui.workspace.homehelp: Choose a workspace or return to your last page.
gui.workspace.starthelp: Investigate activity, manage players, and configure server protection from one place. Each workspace keeps its last selected page.
gui.workspace.switchhelp: Switch workspaces. Your last selected page is remembered in each workspace.
gui.workspace.permissions: Actions use your server privileges. Settings and dangerous actions keep their existing save and confirmation rules.
